cards.description: Introducing the first jump point into the persistent universe

cards.name: Fauna - Quasi Grazer
cards.description: Introducing the Quasi Grazer fauna into the persistent universe.

cards.name: Server Meshing V1
cards.description: The initial implementation of server meshing, enabling multiple servers per shard.

cards.name: Mission System Refactor
cards.description: Reworking the mission system for Server Meshing compatibility

cards.name: Pyro VI - Terminus
cards.description: Implementing the sixth planet of the Pyro system, Terminus.

cards.name: Pyro V
cards.description: Implementing the fifth planet in the Pyro system, Pyro V.

cards.name: Pyro IV
cards.description: Implementing the fourth planet of the Pyro system, Pyro IV.

cards.name: Pyro III - Bloom
cards.description: Implementing the third planet of the Pyro system, Bloom.

cards.name: Pyro II - Monox
cards.description: Implementing the second planet in the Pyro system, Monox.

cards.name: Pyro I
cards.description: Implementing the first planet in the Pyro system, Pyro I.

cards.name: Asteroid Bases
cards.description: A new location archetype in space with additional gameplay variety.

cards.name: Space Stations - Contested Zones
cards.description: A new location type within space stations designed for an enhanced FPS gameplay experience.

cards.name: Mirai Guardian
cards.description: Building, balancing, and implementing Mirai's heavy fighter, the Guardian and Guardian QI, into the game.

cards.name: Save Stanton & Fight For Pyro
cards.description:
Save Stanton: A new event in Stanton, under assault by pirates, where Citizens support the local authorities.
Fight for Pyro: A new event in Pyro, where Citizens have to support their favorite factions between Citizens For Prosperity, Headhunters, or Frontier Fighters.

cards.name: Supply or Die
cards.description: Supply or Die: a new event coming to the 'verse!

cards.name: MISC Fortune
cards.description: Travel further, cut deeper, and gather more materials with the Fortune’s hull-scraping, external RMC dispenser, and your most trusted crewmate… you.

cards.name: Anvil Hornet F7C-M Super Hornet Heartseeker
cards.description: Designed for pilots whose true love is the pulse-pounding thrill of a harrowing dogfight, Anvil's limited-edition Heartseeker is 'the one' for true combat die-hards.

cards.name: Anvil Hornet F7C-M Super Hornet Mk II
cards.description: The Super Hornet is back and upgraded to Mk II spec, making it deadlier than ever.

cards.name: Executive Ships (Contested Zones)
cards.description: Implementing executive ships as a reward for completing a Contested Zone by unlocking the executive hangar: Anvil F7A Hornet Mk II, Anvil F8C Lightning, Drake Corsair, Drake Cutlass Black, Gatac Syulen.

cards.name: New Missions - Location Repair
cards.description: New mission types introducing repair mechanics, requiring players to restore damaged outposts, first debuting in Pyro’s lawless frontier.

cards.name: Anvil Asgard
cards.description: Introducing Anvil’s new savior of the battlefield, the Asgard - a heavily armored vehicle-dropship equipped for boundless resilience in the hottest combat zones.

cards.name: MISC Starlancer TAC
cards.description: Adding the Starlancer TAC ship, designed for tactical assault and rescue.

cards.name: Hathor Ground Alignment Stations
cards.description: Strategically placed Hathor-operated outposts providing key infrastructure and sandbox gameplay opportunities for planetary operations.

cards.name: Hathor Mining Stations
cards.description: Large-scale mining laser facilities operated by the Hathor Group.

cards.name: Heavy Combat Armor "Antium"
cards.description: A rugged and stylish new armor set tailored for brave adventurers facing new dangers.

cards.name: Mission Giver - Wikelo
cards.description: A new mission giver enters the 'verse, bringing fresh opportunities for players to explore.

cards.name: Mission Giver Location - Wikelo's Emporium
cards.description: A specially designed location to host our latest mission giver, Wikelo, offering a new hub for players to engage in these opportunities.

cards.name: Align and Mine
cards.description: A new open-ended activity blending on-foot exploration with aerial support, creating sandbox gameplay opportunities for daring teams.

cards.name: Arena Commander: New Map - Crossroads of Crime
cards.description: Adding the largest Arena Commander map so far, available in multiple game modes Free Flight, Tank Royale, Team Elimination, Elimination, Single Weapon Elimination, Gun Rush, Kill Collector

cards.name: Arena Commander: New Map - Astor's Clearing
cards.description: Adding a Stanton settlement on microTech, available in Free Flight for exploration.

cards.name: Mirai Guardian MX
cards.description: Adding the Mirai Guardian MX. Keeping the cutting-edge design of its predecessor, the MX refines destruction to a powerful art. Enhanced weaponry and shields mean Mirai, once again, has put you ahead of every other single pilot flying.

cards.name: Greycat MTC
cards.description: Adding the MTC vehicle, Greycat's comprehensive suit and gun storage, defensive weaponry, and its customary off-road ability.

cards.name: Juvenile Valakkar
cards.description: A new creature ready to challenge those who dare to cross its path.

cards.name: Aegis Idris-P
cards.description: Adding the Idris Peacekeeper. A ship that secured our past and continues to define our future, this steadfast, tactical, civilian class incarnation of the UEEN darling is available to fly for the first time.

cards.name: Missions - Animal Population Control
cards.description: Enabling animal population control Missions.

cards.name: "Armor with Horn and String" Wikelo Special
cards.description: Adding Wikelo's Special version of the Antium armor, the Ana Armor Endro.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.1.0)
cards.description: Adding three additional hairstyles with Update 4.1.0

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.1.1)
cards.description: Adding four additional hairstyles with Update 4.1.1

cards.name: Missions - Local Site Maintenance
cards.description: Implementing new missions into the persistent universe, first appearing in Pyro's outposts. Players will be tasked with going to the location and fixing equipment with fuses and repairing pipes (RMC Repair) with the your multi-tool.

cards.name: Item Recovery T0
cards.description: Adding Item Recovery T0, allowing players to respawn with the gear they had equipped at the time of death.

cards.name: Collision Physics Update
cards.description: Updating ship collision damage handling, with full collision data passed down by physics.

cards.name: Ground Vehicle and FPS Mining Update
cards.description: Splitting out Ground Vehicles and FPS Minables to make the two gameplays more distinct. Also adding new minables that are exclusive to Ground Vehicles and FPS separately.

cards.name: Argo ATLS GEO
cards.description: Adding Argo’s ATLS GEO: A power suit dedicated to Mining, with practical augmentations including lasers, storage, and a new way to travel with jump packs.

cards.name: Drake Golem
cards.description: Adding Drake's new Mining Starter Ship.

cards.name: VOLT SMG "Quartz"
cards.description: Adding a compact yet devastating firearm designed for those who need maximum firepower in a minimal frame.

cards.name: Heavy Fighter Archetype Balance Pass
cards.description: Balancing Heavy Fighters joint health, thruster power, and max speed.

cards.name: Ships and Vehicles Update
cards.description: Updating the Caterpillar's side elevators to improve its cargo management. Removing the 300i cargo railing to allow for better cargo gameplay, and reatly increasing the SRV fuel storage. Further Hornet and Starlancer MAX flight mass changes.

cards.name: Ship Turret Updates
cards.description: Updating the Reclaimer, Carrack, Valkyrie, Raft, and Starlifter to have several of their turrets linked to the main pilots' weapons.

cards.name: Mission - Hunt The Polaris
cards.description: Adding a new Fleet Week mission. A Polaris has been stolen by the Frontier Fighters and the CDF are tasked by the UEE Navy to hunt it through the Stanton system, isolate it, and kill it.

cards.name: Space Combat Mission - Patrol
cards.description: Adding a Patrol mission that takes the player through a series of patrol points. At each waypoint, players can run into a variety of objectives and encounters.

cards.name: VOLT AR "Parallax"
cards.description: A powerful new weapon boasting a unique blend of characteristics, firepower, and tactical potential.

cards.name: Grenade Launcher Balance Pass
cards.description: Balancing the Grenade Launcher's damage output and handling to reward aiming rather than spamming.

cards.name: Space Combat Mission - Ambush
cards.description: Adding an Ambush mission that tasks players to set up a trap in an asteroid cluster and ambush high value target ships as they pass by.

cards.name: Space Combat Mission - UEE Training Missions
cards.description: Adding a suite of UEE Training Missions that teach players about various ship combat scenarios, introducing new challenges as the player progresses.

cards.name: Wikelo Special Ships (4.1.0)
cards.description: Adding the following Special Ships to Wikelo's Emporium: Anvil F8C Lightning (Sneak), Anvil F8C Lightning (War), RSI Polaris, RSI Scorpius, RSI Constellation Taurus, Mirai Guardian, Crusader C1 Spirit, with upgraded components and a unique base livery. These rewards can be unlocked by completing Wikelo's contract.

cards.name: Components Balance Pass
cards.description: Balancing ships components, and shield generators, based on their class types.

cards.name: Wikelo Special Ships (4.1.1)
cards.description: Adding the following Special Ships to Wikelo's Emporium: MISC Starlancer MAX, Aegis Sabre Firebird, Aegis Sabre Peregrine, RSI Zeus ES, RSI Zeus CL, Crusader Intrepid, with upgraded components and a unique base livery. These rewards can be unlocked by completing Wikelo's contract.

cards.name: VOLT Shotgun "Prism"
cards.description: Adding a cutting-edge energy shotgun that ramps up its pellet spread with heat, delivering brutal close-range bursts powered by VOLT.

cards.name: Dynamic Rain
cards.description: Adding dynamic rain in specific locations, as a first step toward Genesis: Dynamic Weather.

cards.name: Radiation
cards.description: Implementing dangerous radiation zones in specific locations, forcing players to adapt with specialized gear and strategic navigation.

cards.name: Sterling Exploration Suit
cards.description: Introducing the Sterling Exploration Suit: a heavy utility armor built to withstand extreme radiation, enabling safe traversal through the most hazardous zones.

cards.name: Irradiated Apex Valakkar
cards.description: Adding the irradiated Apex Valakkar that players can find near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card.

cards.name: VOLT Pistol "Pulse"
cards.description: Introducing a powerful new pistol from VOLT’s specialized arsenal: a high-capacity, fully automatic sidearm that ramps up its rate of fire as it heats up.

cards.name: Global Event Tracking Service
cards.description: Implementing a new system allowing our systems to track players progression across multiple shards.

cards.name: Lazarus Complexes
cards.description: Strategically located on Pyro I, Associated Science and Development facilities that provided essential infrastructure and sandbox gameplay opportunities for planetary operations.

cards.name: Farro Datacenters
cards.description: Strategically placed on Pyro IV, Associated Science and Development datacenters are providing key infrastructure and sandbox gameplay opportunities for planetary operations.

cards.name: ARGO ATLS IKTI
cards.description: Adding the ATLS IKTI, and ATLS GEO IKTI: versatile new combat suits developed for upcoming challenges, ready to prove their value in an upcoming new Sandbox Activity.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.2.0)
cards.description: Adding four additional hairstyles.

cards.name: Irradiated Adult Valakkar
cards.description: Adding the irradiated Adult Valakkar that players can find near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card.

cards.name: Global Event: Resource Drive (4.2.1)
cards.description: Adding a global, cross-shard event that builds on collaboration and competition.

cards.name: Irradiated Juvenile Valakkar
cards.description: Adding the irradiated Juvenile Valakkar that players can find near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card.

cards.name: New Wikelo Special Ships (4.2.0)
cards.description: Adding multiple new ships and vehicles to the ever-expanding Wikelo's Emporium: Mirai Guardian QI, Anvil Mk2 Super Hornet, MISC Fortune, Aopoa Nox, Mirai Pulse, RSI Ursa Medivac, with upgraded components and a unique base livery. These rewards can be unlocked by completing Wikelo's contract.

cards.name: Medium Utility Armor "Strata" - Corporation Liveries
cards.description: Adding a new Medium Utility Armor "Strata" - Corporation Liveries; as rewards for participating in 4.2.1's Global Event.

cards.name: Space Combat Mission - Support Ship (4.2.1)
cards.description: Adding new missions focused around Escorting Ships that are under immediate threat.

cards.name: Irradiated Kopion
cards.description: Adding the irradiated Kopion that players can find roaming near the Research Facility while doing the Storm Breaker sandbox activity. This was previously listed under the "New Creatures" card. These hostile beasts hunt in packs!

cards.name: Esperia Prowler Utility
cards.description: Implementing the Esperia Prowler Utility into the game.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.2.1)
cards.description: Adding two additional hairstyles.

cards.name: Missions - Collection
cards.description: Improving Wikelo's Emporium missions, allowing players to specifically focus on the ships and gear they want to unlock.

cards.name: RSI Meteor
cards.description: Implementing the RSI Meteor.

cards.name: Ship Flight Tuning Changes: Medium & Heavy Fighters (4.2.1)
cards.description: Updates on Heavy Fighters & Interceptors, Medium Fighters, Gun Boats, and other medium-size ships.

cards.name: Frontier Fighters Finale
cards.description: A new event in 4.3.2 related to the Pyro Must Burn storyline.

cards.name: Ship Flight Tuning Changes: Light Fighters (4.3.0)
cards.description: Updates on Light Fighters for the Gladius, Arrow, Hawk, Banu Defender, Talon, Blade, Khartu-Al, and Mustang.

cards.name: Kruger L-21 Wolf
cards.description: Implementing the Light Fighter Kruger L-21 Wolf, a classic built for the 30th century.

cards.name: Ladder Improvements
cards.description: Improving the reliability and use of ladders in-game.

cards.name: NPC Dropships
cards.description: Introducing Dropships in Pyro, defending outposts and deploying reinforcements when the local population is attacked.

cards.name: Dynamic Snow
cards.description: Introducing dynamic snow to select locations where snow already exists, leveraging the same environmental systems that power dynamic rain. This means snowfall will now appear based on weather conditions.

cards.name: Medical Gameplay Improvements
cards.description: Implementing MedGel and expanding the overall medical gameplay loop, with deeper mechanics around respawning and tiered injury treatment.

cards.name: Wikelo Special Ships (4.3.0)
cards.description: Adding multiple new vehicles and equipment to the ever-expanding Wikelo's Emporium: MISC Starlancer TAC, Drake Golem, Anvil Terrapin Medic, with upgraded components and a unique base livery. These rewards can be unlocked by completing Wikelo's contract.

cards.name: VOLT Sniper "Zenith"
cards.description: Introducing a powerful new weapon that combines the raw punch of a charged sniper shot with the rapid-fire precision of a marksman rifle, the zenith sniper rifles ability to automatically charge when held giving you far more flexibility in the battlefield at the cost of being audible to possible hostiles. Managing heat is however crucial, as overheating renders the weapon temporarily inoperable, leaving players exposed to enemy fire.

cards.name: Sniper Light Armor "Geist"
cards.description: Adding a new Sniper Light Armor "Geist", specialized in stealth gameplay, with high mobility.

cards.name: Onyx Facilities (4.3.0)
cards.description: 4.3.0 includes the Research and Engineering wings. The Onyx Facilities are a network of abandoned research sites scattered throughout the Stanton system, on every moons. While there is still light security in these locations, ASD has abandoned the facilities. Players and mercenary NPCs alike will be exploring these derelict Associated Science and Development (ASD) installations to recover data, solve puzzles, and uncover the mysteries within these hazardous environments.

cards.name: Armor and Ballistic Damage Update
cards.description: Reviewing all ship ballistic weapons to improve their overall effectiveness.

cards.name: Wikelo Light Combat Stealth Suit
cards.description: Adding the Special Light Combat Stealth Suit to Wikelo's Emporium.

cards.name: VOLT LMG "Fresnel"
cards.description: Introducing VOLT's heavy-hitter, a machine-gun that ramps up the punishment as it heats up, trading rate of fire for raw stopping power. As it nears peak overheat, it unleashes searing energy blasts capable of tearing through hostile forces with terrifying efficiency. Featuring a hefty reload time but with a high capacity magazine.

cards.name: RSI Apollo Triage
cards.description: Implementing the Apollo Triage from Roberts Space Industries

cards.name: Onyx Facilities (4.3.1)
cards.description: Update 4.3.1 expands the Onyx Facilities with the addition of Site-B, and additional content to the Research and Engineering wings. Arken Mallor invites players back to the network of abandoned research sites scattered across the Stanton system, hidden on nearly every moon. Though light security still lingers, the facilities have long since been abandoned by Associated Science and Development (ASD). At their deepest point lies Dr. Jorrit’s Lab, where the darkest revelations await.

cards.name: Yormandi
cards.description: A large creature introduced in Alpha 4.3.2, the Yormandi lurks in the depths of the Onyx Facilities.

cards.name: ASD Light Combat Stealth Suit
cards.description: Adding the ASD Light Combat Stealth Suit, a rare loot that can be found in the Onyx Facilities.

cards.name: RSI Apollo Medivac
cards.description: Implementing the Apollo Medivac from Roberts Space Industries; now with superior armor and dual missile racks for deployment on intense battlefields.

cards.name: Behring Laser Cannon Art Refactors
cards.description: Updating the Behring cannons' art style and geometry: Size 1, 2, and 3.

cards.name: Yormandi Cave
cards.description: Deep within Site-B at the Onyx Facilities lies the hidden lair of the Yormandi, waiting to be uncovered.

cards.name: Missiles Damage Radius Update
cards.description: Adjusting the missile explosion radii of all missiles from Size 1 to Size 7, to support their overall effectiveness.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.3.0)
cards.description: Adding three new additional hairstyles.

cards.name: Structural Salvage Update
cards.description: Additional balancing of structural salvage as part of ongoing refining changes related to upcoming work on crafting.

cards.name: New Wikelo Ship Offerings (4.3.2)
cards.description: Adding multiple new vehicles and equipment to the ever-expanding Wikelo's Emporium: Crusader A2 Hercules, Crusader Ares Starfighter Inferno and Ion, Esperia Prowler Utility, with upgraded components and a unique base livery. These rewards can be unlocked by completing Wikelo's contracts.

cards.name: Klaus & Werner Laser Repeater Art Refactors
cards.description: Updating several Klaus & Werner Laser Repeaters' art style and geometry: Size 1, 2, and 3.

cards.name: Mission Pickup on Location
cards.description: Enabling new missions to be discovered and added to journals when you approach or enter a designated area. This is first being introduced to Wikelo's Imperium.

cards.name: Anvil Paladin
cards.description: Introducing Anvil Aerospace’s latest gunship: the Paladin.

cards.name: Assault Rifle "Killshot Rifle"
cards.description: Featuring both a ballistic and energy projectile, this rifle fires each in tandem giving you the best of both worlds with a competitive magazine size, high damage and a punchy aim profile.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.3.1)
cards.description: Adding two new additional hairstyles.

cards.name: Esperia Stinger
cards.description: Implementing Esperia's latest Vanduul replica, the Heavy Fighter Stinger.

cards.name: LMG "Pulverizer"
cards.description: This LMG features a massive drum mag firing 50.cal rounds down range at targets, hitting as hard as it looks with a low RPM and deadly damage. It uses the same profile as the recent VOLT LMG, allowing you to fire at targets from longer distances.

cards.name: Grey's Market Shiv
cards.description: Implementing Grey's Market's first ship to the 'verse: the Shiv.

cards.name: Blade "VCK-1"
cards.description: These Vanduul-inspired knives are a new melee weapon using the classic melee mechanics, but with a deadly alien twist.

cards.name: Heavy Utility Tech Armor "Corbel"
cards.description: Adding a new Heavy Utility Tech Armor.

cards.name: Monocular Range Finders
cards.description: The Monocular Range Finders make surveying the battlefield easier, with a 10x zoom to spot hostiles at distance and light amplification providing greater night visibility.

cards.name: Heavy Battle Tech Armor "Palatino"
cards.description: Adding a new Heavy Battle Tech Armor.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.3.2)
cards.description: Adding two new hairstyles.

cards.name: Interstellar Hauling Missions
cards.description: Implementing hauling missions that start in one system and finish in another.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.4.0)
cards.description: Adding one additional hairstyle, and eleven new facial hair customization for your character.

cards.name: Nyx System
cards.description: Implementing the Nyx star system into the persistent universe.

cards.name: Delamar
cards.description: Implementing Delamar, an inhabited asteroid in the Nyx system, home to the settlement of Levski.

cards.name: Sworn Enemies
cards.description: Implementing a new operation welcoming players to Nyx. InterSec is looking for contractors willing to investigate abandoned QV Logistics stations to follow the trail of Vanduul tech that was sold to ASD.

cards.name: New Wikelo Ship Offerings (4.4.0)
cards.description: Adding multiple new vehicles and equipment to the ever-expanding Wikelo's Emporium: RSI Meteor and the Guardian MX, with upgraded components and a unique base livery. These rewards can be unlocked by completing Wikelo's contracts.

cards.name: AI FPS Turrets
cards.description: Adding anti-personnel turrets for players to avoid or destroy, providing additional PvE challenges.

cards.name: Exterior Freight Elevators
cards.description: Adding new ways of loading and unloading cargo in the currently available systems: Nyx, Stanton, and Pyro.

cards.name: Medium Battle Tech Armor
cards.description: Adding a new Medium Battle Tech Armor.

cards.name: Nyx Missions (Pack 1)
cards.description: Adding a first pack of missions to Nyx, using existing archetypes with a fresh new narrative spin against new enemies.

cards.name: RSI Perseus
cards.description: Implementing the Perseus from Roberts Space Industries.

cards.name: Wikelo Medium Battle Tech Armor
cards.description: Adding a new Wikelo Medium Battle Tech Armor that players can obtain by completing the according mission from Wikelo's Emporium.

cards.name: Glaciem Ring
cards.description: Implementing the Glaciem Ring, a dense asteroid belt located in the Nyx system.

cards.name: RSI Salvation
cards.description: Implementing the Salvation from Roberts Space Industries.

cards.name: Shotgun Pistol "TripleDown"
cards.description: Bolt action, mag drum, triple barrel and a buckshot pistol.

cards.name: Nyx Jump Points
cards.description: Introducing jump points between Nyx and Pyro, and between Nyx and Stanton.

cards.name: Levski
cards.description: Implementing Levski, a settlement on the asteroid Delamar in the Nyx system.

cards.name: Drake Clipper
cards.description: Implementing the Clipper from Drake Interplanetary.

cards.name: Missile Launcher "Boomtube"
cards.description: Three rockets strapped together in a tube releasing a single deadly payload. This weapon has high spread and an arming distance leaning into its chaotic unpredictable nature of finding the sweet spot distance.

cards.name: Vanduul NPC Pilots
cards.description: The Stinger, Glaive, Scythe, and Blade make an appearance as NPC ships flown by Vanduul.

cards.name: QV Logistics Stations
cards.description: Implementing abandoned QV Logistics Stations across Nyx, some now occupied by a new enemy faction.

cards.name: Drake Golem OX
cards.description: Implementing the Golem OX from Drake Interplanetary.

cards.name: MaxOx Neutron Cannon Art Refactors Size 1-2
cards.description: Updating several MaxOx Neutron Cannons' art style and geometry: Size 1 and 2.

cards.name: Kruger L-22 Alpha Wolf
cards.description: Implementing the L-22 Alpha Wolf from Kruger Intergalactic.

cards.name: Greycat MDC
cards.description: Implementing the MDC from Greycat Industrial.

cards.name: Physical Helmets
cards.description: Implementing physical helmets in the persistent universe. Pick one up, rotate it, inspect every detail, carry it around, attach it to your hip, or toss it across a room if you want. When you equip a helmet, you put on or remove the same one you held in your hands, complete with a fully realized interior.

cards.name: Vulkan Renderer Improvements
cards.description: Increasing both the stability and speed of the Vulkan renderer, with many crash fixes, diagnostic improvements, and multi-threaded render-submission, while adding support for HDR and NVidia's DLSS Transformer model. Also included is an overhaul to the Graphics Options, with many new settings, and a VRAM bar to help players configure the graphics for their GPU.

cards.name: FPS AI Improvements
cards.description: Implementing improvements to FPS combat AI for smarter decision making, refined perception, and more reliable reactions in combat. This includes better cover use, grenade targeting, friend or foe checks, group awareness, and animation sync support to make encounters feel more tactical and responsive.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.5.0)
cards.description: Adding three additional hairstyles, and one new facial hair customization for your character.

cards.name: RSI Meteor (Contested Zones)
cards.description: Implementing an executive ship as a reward for completing a Contested Zone by unlocking the executive hangar: RSI Meteor.

cards.name: Engineering Gameplay
cards.description: Introducing dedicated engineering roles aboard ships, allowing players to actively manage power distribution, repairs, and system efficiency in real time.

cards.name: New Weapon Attachments
cards.description: Implementing a host of new attachments, including low zoom VOLT optics with charge/heat measurements readings, low zoom Klaus & Werner scopes, new barrel attachments with scorched/tweaker power levels, as well as a new tactical VOLT flashlight.

cards.name: Fire Hazards
cards.description: Bringing fire hazards to ships and environments, along with Fire Extinguisher mechanics, requiring players to manage and extinguish blazes before they spread.

cards.name: Loot Refresh
cards.description: Rebalancing loot at various sandbox locations and introducing previously Wikelo-exclusive rewards to the loot pool.

cards.name: Ship Flight Tuning Changes: Snub Fighters & Interceptors
cards.description: Updates on Snub Fighters and Interceptors for the Mirai Fury (and variants), Origin 85X, Kruger P-52, Kruger P-72, Mirai Razor (and variants), Origin M50, Aegis Avenger (and variants), Origin 300i series. This includes SCM & NAV speeds, accelerations, angular speeds, rotations, health points, and racing ships adjustments.

cards.name: New Wikelo Ship Offerings (4.5.0)
cards.description: Adding multiple new vehicles and equipment to the ever-expanding Wikelo's Emporium: Aegis Idris, Anvil Asgard, MISC Prospector, Argo RAFT, and Kruger L-21 Wolf, with upgraded components and a unique base livery. A unique military Kruger L-21 Wolf can also be unlocked by completing other Wikelo Ships Offerings. These rewards can be obtained by completing Wikelo's contracts.

cards.name: Wikelo Rebalance (4.5.0)
cards.description: Adding a variety of new ships to Wikelo, alongside a rebalance of effort required to earn Wikelo rewards.

cards.name: Clearing The Air
cards.description: Implementing a system wide crisis on Levski built around the Molina Mold outbreak, sending players across Nyx and Stanton on Hauling, Courier, Resource Gathering, Kill Ship, Recover Cargo, Station Escort, and Defend Ship missions.

cards.name: Kel-To Ship Supply Kiosks
cards.description: Implementing small, Kel-To owned ship supply kiosks at major cities in Stanton, giving crews quick access to engineering tools and essential provisions.

cards.name: FPS Weapons Art Refactor
cards.description: Updating visual material and texture for the following weapons and equipments: Behring P4-AR, FS-9, and P6-LR; Greycat MaxLift Tractor Beam and Cambio SRT; CureLife ParaMed Medical Device; and Ripper SMG.

cards.name: Cockpit Light Amplification (LAMP)
cards.description: Implementing light amplification on the canopies of a limited set of vehicles, allowing players to more easily navigate the 'verse in low-light conditions, with more ships to be supported in the future.

cards.name: RSI Aurora Series - Gold Standard
cards.description: Updating the Aurora series to Gold Standard, and implementing improvements including updated art, gameplay updates, physicalized components, a refreshed HUD, and more.

cards.name: Medical Light Armor "Chiron"
cards.description: Implementing the new Medical Light Armor "Chiron".

cards.name: New Resource Gathering Missions
cards.description: Implementing an expanded list of missions to our Resource Gathering archetype. Find, gather and deliver raw or refined mineable ores or salvageable ship pieces for a variety of corporations. Scheduled to come in a 4.6.x patch.

cards.name: Ground Vehicles Missiles
cards.description: Implementing ground-vehicle-only missile variants available to the Cyclone AA/MT, Nova, Storm AA, and Ballista, with improved tuning to make atmospheric anti-air threats more dangerous.

cards.name: RSI Hermes
cards.description: Implementing RSI's new medium freighter: large capacity, fast pace, high endurance.

cards.name: Argo MOTH
cards.description: Implementing Argo’s new medium salvager: The MOTH has the tools to earn its keep, the storage for a long job, and the weaponry to work unencumbered.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.7.0)
cards.description: Adding six new hairstyles.

cards.name: Crafting T0
cards.description: Implementing the first iteration of Crafting, introducing earnable blueprints, material quality, and the ability to improve existing item stats through the crafting process. This initial release focuses primarily on crafting weapons and armor.

cards.name: FPS Weapons Art Refactor
cards.description: Updating visual material and texture for the following weapons and equipment: Behring: BR-2, GP-33, P8-AR, P8-SC, S-38 / Gemini: A03, C54, LH86, R97, S71 / Klaus and Werner: Arclight, Arrowhead, Demeco, Gallant, Lumin / Lightning Bolt Co.: Yubarev, Atzkav / Kastak Arms: Karna / APX Fire Extinguisher

cards.name: New Wikelo Ship Offerings (4.7.0)
cards.description: Adding an RSI Apollo Triage with a unique base livery and upgraded components as a reward for completing a new addition to the variety of available Wikelo's Emporium contracts.

cards.name: Ice Juvenile Valakkar
cards.description: Adding the Ice Juvenile Valakkar that players can find within QV Breaker Stations.

cards.name: People's Service Stations
cards.description: Implementing social stations in Nyx. Managed by members of the People's Alliance, these service stations offer a safe haven with basic restock, rearm, and refueling operations for pilots traveling through Nyx.

cards.name: Nyx Missions (Pack 2)
cards.description: Introducing a second pack of missions to Nyx, featuring hauling, combat, and salvage gameplay opportunities.

cards.name: MaxOx Neutron Cannon Size 3
cards.description: Implementing a new Size 3 neutron weapon in the Persistent Universe: the MaxOx NN-15 Cannon.

cards.name: Light Combat Armor "Clash"
cards.description: Implementing a rework of a light combat armor in the persistent universe.

cards.name: Inventory Rework
cards.description: Reworking the visuals and improving the overall user experience of the Personal Inventory UI introduced in 3.15. This update includes new functionality such as proximity looting, stack all, and more.

cards.name: Ice Adult Valakkar
cards.description: Adding the Ice Adult Valakkar that players can find within QV Breaker Stations.

cards.name: QV Breaker Stations
cards.description: Located in the Keeger Belt, QV Breaker Stations provide key infrastructure and operations, accessible through contracts: "QV Breaker Station Mining Rights", either "Exclusive" or "Shared".

cards.name: RSI Aurora Mk II
cards.description: Implementing the RSI Aurora Mk II, building upon RSI’s legacy as the starting point of exploration, progression, and expedition.

cards.name: Heavy Combat Armor "Monde"
cards.description: Implementing a heavy combat armor in the persistent universe.

cards.name: MISC Hull B
cards.description: Implementing MISC's Hull B, built for serious haulers looking to take their business to the next level and beyond.

cards.name: Claw Salamanders Faction Outfits
cards.description: Implementing multiple outfit variants for the Claw Salamanders gang in Nyx: A complete Light Armor, a cape, and a mask.

cards.name: Greycat UTV
cards.description: Implementing Greycat's UTV, delivering dependable and durable ground transport when it matters most.

cards.name: Refueling Missions
cards.description: Implementing refueling missions centered on servicing NPC ships. Players will also be able to request refueling via a beacon, which will initially be fulfilled by NPCs.

cards.name: Aegis Hammerhead - Gold Standard
cards.description: Updating the Aegis Hammerhead to Gold Standard, and implementing improvements and updated interior art.

cards.name: QV Extraction Stations
cards.description: Located in the Nyx system, the QV Extraction Stations provide key infrastructure for the new Tactical Strike Groups content.

cards.name: Tactical Strike Groups
cards.description: Implementing a new cooperative ship combat experience featuring a series of objectives and challenges designed for a multi-role fleet. Players are encouraged to bring a diverse lineup, equip the right loadouts, and be ready to refuel and resupply both ships and FPS players on site to succeed.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.8.0)
cards.description: Implementing seven new hairstyles and one new beard, along with updates to one hairstyle and one beard to bring them up to current quality standards.

cards.name: Transport System
cards.description: Implementing the new Transport System first in Grim Hex: a full rewrite of transit across the universe, supporting trams, trains, and elevators with improved reliability and scalability for technologies like Server Meshing and Instancing.

cards.name: UltiFlex "Novian" Crossbow
cards.description: Implementing the long-awaited crossbow, featuring a devastating, shattering bolt and harsh projectile drop, the UltiFlex "Novian" Crossbow rewards skilled aim with immense power. Its near-silent firing mechanism lets you strike quietly and gain the upper hand on your foes.

cards.name: New Wikelo Ship Offerings (4.8.0)
cards.description: Adding a L-22 Alpha Wolf with a unique base livery and upgraded components as a reward for completing a new addition to the variety of available Wikelo's Emporium contracts.

cards.name: Refueling Improvements
cards.description: Improving refueling and docking by simplifying fuel delivery, enabling mutual docking requests, and adding automatic docking at close range, alongside more meaningful itemization for fuel capacity and transfer speeds.

cards.name: Kastak Arms - Plasma Grenade
cards.description: Implementing Kastak Arms area-denial grenade. Prime and throw to lock down an area and prevent enemies from pushing through.

cards.name: Space Combat Missions - Defend Location
cards.description: Implementing a new Mission Pack for players to answer the call from either Foxwell or Headhunters. Defend asteroid bases throughout the systems, prevent the attackers from destroying key resources, and sometimes escort escaping workers to safety.

cards.name: Flight Suit "Tailwind"
cards.description: Implementing the "Tailwind" Flight Suit in the persistent universe.

cards.name: Item Recovery: Vehicle Loadouts
cards.description: Adding the ability for players to save and claim vehicle loadouts via the ASOP Terminals. Claimed vehicles and their components will now be bricked after some time. Includes a major refactor of the Entitlement Service and extension of the Item Imprint system to ensure player owned vehicles persist reliably.

cards.name: Flight Suits G-Force Resistance
cards.description: Implementing G-Force resistance modifiers to flight suits, enabling players to choose specialized equipment for improved maneuverability and endurance.

cards.name: FPS Weapons Art Refactor
cards.description: Updating visual material and texture for the following weapons and equipment: Deadrig Shotgun + Kastak Arms: Custodian, Ravager, Scalpel, Coda, Devastator.

cards.name: Drake Ironclad
cards.description: Implementing Drake's newest hauler: the Drake Ironclad. 2204 SCU of open-roof and ramp-accessible cargo, plus heavy-duty durability and weapons!

cards.name: Ship Hangar Service T0
cards.description: Implementing service gameplay updates that draw from resources stored in your ship’s cargo grid to fulfill refueling, repair, and restocking requests.

cards.name: Drake Ironclad Assault
cards.description: Implementing the Drake Ironclad Assault. Additional turrets, 34 infantry in jump seats, a 1440 SCU cargo hold worth of resources, plus room for a range of combat vehicles and ships in the service bay.

cards.name: Vehicle Command Module
cards.description: Implementing Vehicle Command Module docking/undocking and ship systems transfer.

cards.name: Drake Pitbull
cards.description: Implementing Drake's snub fighter: the Drake Pitbull.

cards.name: Origin M80
cards.description: Implemeting Origin's first heavy fighter: the Origin M80.

cards.name: MISC Starlite
cards.description: Implementing MISC's new starter refueler: the MISC Starlite.

cards.name: Aegis Tiburon
cards.description: Implementing Aegis's new apex predator: the Aegis Tiburon.

cards.name: Gatac Railen
cards.description: Implementing the Gatac Railen. Human-operable yet distinctly alien, the Railen bursts into long-haul transport with agility, vertical design, and remarkable grav-lev employment.

cards.name: Gatac Tyilui
cards.description: Implementing the Gatac Tyilui, the first alien-designed carrier on the market, and also the first ship with a zero-gravity hangar, allowing for an aerial ballet of weightless operation.

cards.name: New Hairstyles (4.9.0)
cards.description: Implementing two new hairstyles, along with an update to one hairstyle to bring it up to current quality standards.

cards.name: Ordnance Cargo Holder
cards.description: Implementing dedicated storage frames for missiles, torpedoes, and bombs placed on cargo grids to improve presentation and handling.

cards.name: Behring "CQ7" Bullpup Rifle
cards.description: Implementing the Behring "CQ7" Bullpup Rifle, a battle rifle purpose-built for close-quarters engagements, combining the compact handling of a bullpup design with the firepower needed for intense frontline and boarding combat.

cards.name: "Support the Miners" Mission Pack
cards.description: Implementing a new set of repeatable missions from Recco Battaglia, an independent mining logistics coordinator based in Levski. Take on a variety of contracts including prospecting, mining, recovery, salvage, investigations, ship reclamation, and more, while building your reputation with Recco to unlock additional opportunities in Alpha 4.9 and beyond. Contracts can be accepted through your mobiGlas.

cards.name: Juvenile and Adult Valakkar Behavior Updates
cards.description: Implementing improvements to Juvenile and Adult Valakkar, updating their combat behavior with more dynamic burrowing, tracking, repositioning, and attack patterns.

cards.name: Ship Fly-By Audio
cards.description: Implementing an overhauled ship fly-by audio system, reintroducing fly-by sounds with all-new audio assets to deliver greater immersion and improved positional feedback during flight.

cards.name: Grey's Market Basher
cards.description: Implementing the Grey's Market Basher. Smash, strike, and strafe your way through the black in a light fighter built from your old favorite parts.

cards.name: Bellator Combat Suit
cards.description: Implementing lightly armored apparel designed to offer a more stylish look while remaining viable in combat situations.

cards.name: Ship Combat UI Improvements
cards.description: Implementing new hit markers for vehicle combat, providing clearer feedback when landing shots.

cards.name: Battaglia's Alliance Ships
cards.description: Implementing three ships attainable through mission progression with Recco Battaglia in Levski, Nyx: the Drake Golem, MISC Prospector, and Argo MOLE, each featuring unique "Alliance" base liveries.

cards.name: Nine Tails Armor Update
cards.description: Implementing updated armor sets for the Nine Tails criminal organization, refreshing the appearance of grunts, elites, and boss NPCs.

cards.name: Apocalypse Arms "Vendetta" HMG (4.10.0)
cards.description: Implementing a brand new weapon type: the Heavy Machine Gun, with the Apocalypse Arms "Vendetta" HMG. Belt-fed and usable with the new Super Heavy Armor and its dedicated ammunition backpack, it delivers sustained high-rate fire from a large rotating barrel while carrying up to four magazines of ammunition.

cards.name: Siege of Orison
cards.description: Implementing a new operation, Siege of Orison, introducing instanced FPS gameplay where players assault Nine Tails-controlled platforms in coordinated team-based encounters tied to mission-driven progression.

cards.name: Instancing Dynamic Meshing Support
cards.description: Implementing Instancing to create closed gameplay spaces with controlled accesses, managed by dynamic workers and assignment from the Dynamic Server Meshing initiative. Access is managed through instance prerequisites, party leader ownership, and safeguards that prevent or remove ineligible players.

cards.name: Mission Giver: Recco Battaglia
cards.description: Introducing Recco Battaglia as an in-person Mission Giver in the Persistent Universe, bringing her narrative mission series to life. Meet with Recco in Levski to uncover the challenges facing independent miners!

cards.name: New Wikelo Ship Offerings (4.10.0)
cards.description: Adding a Drake Clipper with a unique base livery and upgraded components as a reward for completing a new addition to the variety of available Wikelo's Emporium contracts.

cards.name: Orison Relief Support (4.10.1)
cards.description: Implementing the Orison Relief Support event, where players contribute to Orison’s recovery efforts through a variety of missions spanning resource gathering, crafting, hauling, and combat. Released in 4.10.1 patch.

cards.name: Super Heavy Combat "BUL-H4" Armor
cards.description: Implementing the Super Heavy Combat "BUL-H4" armor class, enabling players to equip and operate a new category of powerful super heavy weapons.

cards.name: Fuel Tanks and Consumption Rebalance
cards.description: Implementing balance updates for Quantum and Hydrogen fuel tanks, adjusting fuel capacities and consumption rates to better align with ship sizes and roles.

cards.name: Hedeby Gunworks "Arlington" Lever Action Rifle (4.10.0)
cards.description: Implementing the Hedeby Gunworks "Arlington" Rifle, a lever-action long rifle that blends classic craftsmanship with modern functionality, delivering accurate marksmanship, smooth cycling, and multiple fire modes.

cards.name: Character Customization Update (Brows)
cards.description: Implementing three new eyebrow styles and updating six existing options to bring them up to the current visual quality standard.

cards.name: Kruger Stingray
cards.description: Implementing Kruger's first Medium Fighter, blending timeless styling with a transformative design that adapts its silhouette to the demands of modern flight.

cards.name: RSI Discovery Month Event (4.10.2)
cards.description: Implementing RSI Discovery Month, a limited-time event celebrating the legacy and future of the Constellation, with special RSI installations across Stanton and a variety of Defense, Transport, and Collection missions for players to tackle their way.

cards.name: New Weapon Attachment: Hedeby Gunworks S2 Optic (4.10.0)
cards.description: Implementing a new attachment, the Hedeby Gunworks S2 Optic.

cards.name: InterSec Defense Solutions Mission Pack (4.10.3)
cards.description: Implementing an expansion of InterSec Defense Solutions' contracts in Nyx, introducing new missions and gameplay opportunities centered on fighting the growing Vanduul threat, alongside new blueprints for players to earn.

cards.name: Lightning Bolt Company "Skarnov" DMR (4.10.3)
cards.description: ⁠Implementing the Lightning Bolt Company "Skarnov" DMR, a fully automatic designated marksman rifle whose specialized projectiles create electrical discharges between multiple targets, making it highly effective against groups of hostiles.

cards.name: RSI Constellation series Mk IV Gold Standard
cards.description: Updating the Constellation series Mk IV to Gold Standard, with improvements including updated art, gameplay updates, physicalized components, improved cockpit visibility, a refreshed HUD, and more.

cards.name: RSI Constellation Mk V Centaurus
cards.description: Implementing the RSI Constellation Mk V Centaurus, a convention-defying ship that takes on cargo, combat, and more. This multi-role, multi-crew ship brings RSI’s legacy of experience to the next generation with this impressive evolution of one of its most beloved and iconic ships.

cards.name: RSI Skylark
cards.description: Implementing the RSI Skylark, a snub fighter nestled within the Constellation’s reimagined hull.

cards.name: Heavy Combat Armor "Monolith"
cards.description: Implementing a heavy combat armor in the persistent universe.

cards.name: New Wikelo Ship Offerings: Tiburon
cards.description: Adding an Aegis Tiburon with a unique base livery and upgraded components as a reward for completing a new addition to the variety of available Wikelo's Emporium contracts.

cards.name: Associated Science And Development "Model-K2" DMR
cards.description: Implementing the Associated Science And Development "Model-K2" Designated Marksman Rifle, a versatile energy weapon that builds heat during sustained fire allowing operators to switch fire mode using heat to unleash powerful ultra fast projectiles

cards.name: Genesis: Starchitect
cards.description: Implementing Starchitect, a new procedural world-building system that automatically scatters sectors, clusters, and locations across planetary bodies while constructing locations from modular tiles. Using Genesis data to identify suitable placement for game objects, Starchitect introduces a new workflow for populating planets and building large-scale locations across an expanding universe.

cards.name: Starchitect Mission Pack
cards.description: Implementing new sandbox missions across sprawling planetary locations designed to keep players planetside for longer, with focus on more localized objectives.

cards.name: Nyx I
cards.description: Nyx I is a coreless planet that orbits closest to the sun in the Nyx system. Once considered impossible to terraform, Nyx I has undergone a drastic transformation thanks to new experimental technology developed by Genesis Terraforming and now features a robust ecosphere capable of supporting a wide diversity of life.

cards.name: Contract Boards
cards.description: Implementing Contract Boards as a new way to discover and accept faction and guild missions at local, regional, global, and solar system levels through Guild Halls and hubs across the 'verse, featuring a brand-new interface that makes browsing contracts and filtering by faction easier and more intuitive.

cards.name: Genesis: Planet Tech v5
cards.description: Implementing Planet Tech V5, a complete rework of how planets are built, populated, and rendered. Introducing emergent biomes driven by realistic physical properties, and scattering plants and rocks according to their natural behaviour, reworking terrain shading across materials like sand, dirt, rock, and snow, and moving generation and spawning to the GPU to support denser environments with improved rendering performance.

cards.name: Starchitect POIs
cards.description: Implementing new ground locations owned by various factions, offering a variety of procedurally generated combinations of building compositions. These will support a wide variety of mission archetypes and gameplay loops.

cards.name: S3 & S10 Bomb Racks
cards.description: Implementing Size 10 and Size 3 bomb racks at shops in the PU, expanding support for different bomb sizes and loadout configurations.

cards.name: Vehicle Combat Balance Pass
cards.description: Implementing a weapon balancing pass for ship combat, with a focus on fighter combat and adjustments to weapon performance, time to kill, and the balance between energy and ballistic weapons.

cards.name: Loot Refresh
cards.description: Rebalancing loot at various sandbox locations and introducing previously Wikelo-exclusive rewards to the loot pool.

cards.name: Genesis: Population Manager
cards.description: Implementing the Population Manager tech. Its primary goal is to load balance the server population and create inhabitants appropriate to their local environment, while enabling more complex interactions between agents focused on a dynamic context.

cards.name: Kastak Arms "Hellion" Pistol
cards.description: Implementing the Hellion Plasma Pistol, a high-velocity plasma weapon that creates hazardous impact zones, allowing operators to rapidly deploy multiple areas of denial across the battlefield.

cards.name: DGS Planet Subdivision
cards.description: Implementing a tech that allows us to subdivide planets and moons into smaller territories, so a single Dynamic Game Server (DGS) is never responsible for an entire body. Territory boundaries are generated from spatial clustering of seeded entities scattered by Genesis, and dynamically assigned to available DGSs, improving load distribution and paving the way for finer‑grained server meshing at planetary scale. Nyx 1 will be the first planet to use this tech.

cards.name: Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements
cards.description: Implementing Item Recovery: Ship Loadout Improvements, updating ship and item recovery to better support custom loadouts through timed claims, optional expedite fees, freight elevator item claims, and debuting a free recovery option when losses are detected as outside the player’s control.

cards.name: Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG
cards.description: Implementing the Kastak Arms "Verdict" LMG, a medium-range weapon that builds heat through sustained fire before unleashing devastating superheated plasma projectiles with its alternate fire mode.

cards.name: Nyx II
cards.description: With high temperatures and a high-pressure atmosphere dense with thick clouds, Nyx II is an inhospitable planet where protective gear is recommended. While some resources dot the surface, the risk involved in harvesting them has left the planet almost void of commercial development.

cards.name: Nyx III
cards.description: Nyx III is an ice giant that lacks a breathable atmosphere and is considered a difficult candidate for expansive commercial resource extraction.

cards.name: Imperial Sports Federation
cards.description: A league of sporting organizations that banded together to standardize competitive sports throughout the Empire.

cards.name: The Council
cards.description: Organized as the "governing body for illegality," the Council is a collective of syndicates, gangs, and outlaws who mandate criminal activity throughout the systems.

cards.name: Mercenary Guild
cards.description: Formed after first contact with the Xi'an, the Mercenary Guild provides combat and logistical expertise to all corners of the universe.

cards.name: Academy of Sciences
cards.description: Originally based out of Rhetor, the Academy of Sciences has expanded to become a congress of scholars dedicated to the expansion of knowledge throughout the universe.

cards.name: United Resource Workers
cards.description: Protecting the people who are the lifeblood of industry, the United Resource Workers can always be found hunting the harvesting minerals, scavenging or crafting.

cards.name: Interstellar Transport Guild
cards.description: One of the oldest professional unions in the UEE, the Interstellar Transport Guild oversees the movement of goods and people throughout the universe.

cards.name: Player Space Stations
cards.description: Implementing the ability to build homes among the stars with the introduction of player-made space bases.

cards.name: Crafting
cards.description: Implementing the ability for players to craft various items using resources from throughout the persistent universe.

cards.name: Building Interiors
cards.description: Gameplay-focused layouts to fill the interiors of the various buildings in landing zones and other points of interest.

cards.name: Base Building
cards.description: Implementing player-constructed planetary bases.

cards.name: Nyx System
cards.description: Implementing the full Nyx star system into the persistent universe.

cards.name: Castra System
cards.description: Implementing the Castra star system into the persistent universe.

cards.name: Terra System
cards.description: Implementing the Terra star system into the persistent universe.

cards.name: Dynamic Server Meshing
cards.description: Implementation of dynamic scaling and server re-assignment for Server Meshing, allowing for MMO-scale player counts

cards.name: Player-to-Player Trading
cards.description: Implementing the ability for players to set up their own shops and sell wares to other players.

cards.name: Player Organizations
cards.description: Implementing the ability to create and fully manage player organizations, including a dedicated mobiGlas app.

cards.name: Social mobiGlas App
cards.description: Creation of a new mobiGlas app to manage friends and contacts, as well as the ability to easily find and create groups.

cards.name: Citizenship
cards.description: Elevate your status in the 'verse by becoming a Citizen to gain unique rewards and benefits.

cards.name: Station Warfare
cards.description: Introducing Station Warfare, where player organizations battle over multiple ground and space locations to gain the protection of planetary shields in lawless star systems.

cards.name: StarAudio
cards.description: A new suite of tools and tech aimed at improving the quality and fidelity of sound in Star Citizen

cards.name: Global Illumination
cards.description: Implementing Global Illumination, providing further visual improvements to the lighting of both interior and exterior spaces.

cards.name: Planetary Shields
cards.description: Introducing Planetary Shield Tech, which provides maximum protection for ground locations, including player bases, from hostile attacks.

cards.name: Ownership
cards.description: Implementing a robust ownership system for items, vehicles, and more, including the ability to transfer ownership both legally and illegally.

cards.name: Main Story
cards.description: Take on a journey through the Star Citizen universe by experiencing a handcrafted story with unique challenges and rewards

cards.name: Location Stories
cards.description: New missions and narrative arcs set in specific areas, allowing players to experience the uniqueness of various locations in the 'verse.

cards.name: Guilds System
cards.description: Guilds provide rewards and content for different professions to players as they complete contracts and earn reputation.

cards.name: Insurance, Taxes & Warranty
cards.description: New system to handle medical, item and vehicle insurance and associated fees.

cards.name: Law & Security
cards.description: Implementing an updated system that handles law infractions along with security responses to criminal activity.

cards.name: Reputation V2
cards.description: Integrating the Reputation system with Guilds and Rewards, as well as the addition of an improved Reputation App.

cards.name: New Player Professions
cards.description: Addition of new player professions to the persistent universe

cards.name: StarWear
cards.description: Implementing new technology that allows the combination of clothing and armor pieces on characters, further enhancing both player and NPC customization.

cards.name: Death of a Spaceman
cards.description: Introducing permadeath and associated consequences to Star Citizen.

cards.name: AI Blades
cards.description: A new vehicle component enabling to autonomous operation of various aspects of vehicles, such as turrets

cards.name: StarSim
cards.description: Backend systems and tools simulating the state of universe and economy and dynamically responds to players actions

cards.name: Utility Tunnels
cards.description: A new location archetype that brings sandbox content to Landing Zones, such as the Municipal Works under ArcCorp.

cards.name: Quantum Travel
cards.description: The quantum travel experience is becoming fully physical, including Quantum Boosting, a faster method for short-range travel.

cards.name: Item Misfire & Wear
cards.description: Adding depth to equipment functionality with item misfires and gradual wear, requiring regular maintenance to ensure peak performance.

cards.name: Charge & Drain
cards.description: Expanding the utility of the multi-tool with the ability to drain and transfer power between objects, unlocking new puzzle-solving and support roles.

cards.name: Life Support
cards.description: Integrating life support systems into ships, making oxygen management and environmental controls critical for survival.

cards.name: Solar Flare
cards.description: Unleashing powerful solar bursts within the Pyro system, creating dynamic environmental hazards that players must navigate and prepare for.

cards.name: Vehicle Radar & Scanning Rework
cards.description: Reworking Vehicle radar and scanning for all vehicles.

cards.name: FPS Radar & Scanning
cards.description: Implementing first-person radar and scanning gameplay, improving situational awareness and bringing new tactical gameplay.

cards.name: IFCS and Control Surfaces
cards.description: Improving atmospheric flight dynamics with functional control surfaces, allowing for more precise maneuvering and realistic aerodynamics.

cards.name: Hangar Upgrades
cards.description: Expanding personal hangar customization with new upgrades, layouts, and functional improvements.

cards.name: Weapon Overheat
cards.description: Introducing heat buildup and overheat mechanics for energy weapons, requiring careful trigger discipline and heat management during sustained firefights.

cards.name: Realistic Audio Mode
cards.description: A systemic solution for expressing game audio in depressurised states, through effects applied to audio and an increased emphasis on the resonance of sounds through surfaces and physical contact.

cards.name: Genesis: Dynamic Weather
cards.description: Implementing Dynamic Weather, introducing planetary-scale weather fronts with dynamic thunderstorms, dense rain clouds, and snowfall to bring more varied and immersive weather conditions to planetary environments.

cards.name: Maelstrom
cards.description: Implementing a new physically based destruction system.
